attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: MM Forgings Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call organized by 360 One Capital Market Research for Friday, 13 November 2026 at 13:00 Hours IST. The call will discuss the Q2FY27 financial performance. Management representatives Mr. Vidya Shankar Krishnan, Chairman and Managing Director, and Mr. R Raghunathan, Chief Financial Officer, will participate. The meeting is subject to change. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. Pre-registration is available via the provided link. Dial-in numbers are +91 22 6280 1222 and 7115 8123. International toll-free numbers are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. For further information, contact Mr. Annamalai Jayaraj at 360 One Capital Market Research.

attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: M M Forgings Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Indowind Energy Limited reported a consolidated net profit of 302.59 lakh rupees for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The company's basic earnings per share was 0.19 rupees. Hindalco Industries reported a net profit of 7,533 crore rupees for the September 2026 quarter. Revenue increased 39 percent to 91,708 crore rupees. EBITDA was up 42 percent to 13,757 crore rupees. GSPL Transmission Ltd plans to invest around 3,500 crore rupees to expand its natural gas pipeline network. Gujarat Pipavav Port Ltd delayed the commissioning of its three-million-tonne liquid jetty to March or April 2027. Gujarat Energy signed a 10-year agreement with ADNOC to procure up to 4 million tonnes of LNG. Supplies are scheduled to begin in 2028. The High Court of Madras summoned parties to appear on 16 November 2026 in case C.M.P. No. 22263 of 2026.

attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: M M Forgings Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 with the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. The company published the results in Makkal Kural and Business Line. The document includes financial data for M M Forgings Limited, TTK Prestige Limited, and Indowind Energy Limited. TTK Prestige Limited reported its results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 6th November 2026. Indowind Energy Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The filing was signed by N K Haribabu, Director and CFO, on 5th November 2026.

attchmntText: MM Forgings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
